targets.query: from(bucket: "ceres") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unit_tele" and r.unit == "${unit}" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "ph" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "pH"})
